study type: Retrospective cross-sectional study and case-control study
cohort: Patients undergoing a Caesarean section (CS) at Nizwa Hospital, Oman, from 2001 to 2012
finding: The incidence of post-Caesarean surgical site infections was 2.66%, and risk factors included premature rupture of the membranes, diabetes, obesity, hypertension, anaemia, and wound haematoma.
